name: Escape Runhead For Brainrots! [🧱Maze][🌟Event!]
desc:
🚀 Welcome to Escape Runhead For Brainrot!

🏃‍♂️ Run faster, Take more Brainrots!
⚠️ Beware of the Running Head lurking in the maze!
🛡️ Use safe zones and structures to hide from it!
🪜 Spot a ladder? Climb up! It’s your quick way home!

💎 Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more coins!
🎒 Expand your slots to store even more Brainrots!
💤 Earn Cash even while offline—your Brainrots never sleep!
